name: ranking-list
title: Ranking List
description: A ranking with big numbers in a case: the rank in the SFX face (the top ranks biggest, the first place in the accent), an optional 2:3 cover thumbnail in a 2px ink frame, the title in lettering and a subtitle, an optional score, and the change at the end: an up or down brush arrow with its count, an en dash for no change, or a NEW burst. Rows are separated by 2px ink lines. Rows with href are links, rows with onSelect are buttons: both invert to ink on hover, and press to a paper negative with a 2px offset. Logical properties only, so dir=rtl works.
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/ranking-list". Entries are plain data: give href for a link, or onSelect for a button. RankingRow is exported for a single row, for example in a detail page header. Change: a positive number is up, a negative one is down, 0 is no change, "new" is a new entry.

meta.tagline: A weekly ranking with big numbers, covers and change marks.
meta.usage:
import { RankingList, type RankingEntry } from "@/components/manga/ranking-list"

const entries: RankingEntry[] = [
  { id: "glass-harbour", title: "Glass Harbour", subtitle: "M. Sato", change: 0, score: "1.2M", href: "/series/glass-harbour" },
  { id: "iron-lullaby", title: "Iron Lullaby", subtitle: "K. Hadley", change: 3, cover: "/covers/iron-lullaby.jpg", href: "/series/iron-lullaby" },
]

<RankingList entries={entries} />

props.name: entries
props.description: Rows: id, title, subtitle, cover, change (number or "new"), score, href.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Makes the rows without href buttons.

props.name: highlightTop
props.description: Ranks up to this one get the biggest numbers. Rank 1 is in the accent.
